Responsive glassmorphism on mobile is mostly about GPU discipline. If you use uncalibrated backdrop filters, mobile viewports crawl. For Bellora on Salla, we tuned the elevation layers to keep 60fps scrolling intact.

Live preview on the Salla Theme Store:
https://salla.com/themes/1598891211
